title: Install an App from the Library
trigger: User wants to add a new app or tool to OpenKaava

steps.action: Click Install App in the Start section on the Home screen
A native folder picker appears to select the app or tool to install
After installation, the new app appears in the + menu in the switcher bar and in the Apps menu in the title bar
Click the + menu and select the new app to mount it into a pane

outcome: An app or tool is installed and becomes available in the switcher bar and Apps menu
